summary: PNG’s restoration and conservation package emphasizes forest protection and recovery. Restoration includes 10 million trees and 60,000 ha already planted—about 0.15% of its 396,522 km² mapped forest—plus afforestation, reforestation and ecosystem restoration. Conservation combines maintaining NDC-reported forest cover of 78% with 25% reductions by 2030 in deforestation and degradation from 2015 levels, equivalent to 8,300 and 43,300 ha annually. PNG seeks a 10,000 Gg CO₂ eq emissions reduction and an 8,284 Gg CO₂ eq LULUCF net sink by 2030, a more-than-50% round-log export cut in 2025, and scaled-up LMMA coverage, currently 159,259 ha or 0.4% of mapped forest. Agriculture targets concern capacity rather than area: by 2025, 20% of 163,000 smallholders and 63,000 beneficiaries (20% women) will gain climate-resilient capacity, while 50% of 20,000 direct beneficiaries will apply commercial and diversification planning. None specifies hectares within PNG’s 52,492 km² of agriculture.
